seasonal.label: validation counterpart of the pre-registered test-year extras (D-071)
seasonal.rule: each arrival week (Monday 00:00 America/Denver, as the registered weekly totals) belongs to the meteorological season of its Monday's month (DJF, MAM, JJA, SON); a season's weeks need not be contiguous (SON joins the window's two ends); the paired block bootstrap (blocks 2, 4 and 8; 4 primary) runs on a season's weekly totals only when it has at least 8 weeks; descriptive only

forecast_skill.label: validation counterpart of the pre-registered test-year extras (D-071)
forecast_skill.rule: frozen empirical interval: the 10th and 90th percentiles of daily-forecast residuals (truth − forecast) per series and model, over the validation selection issues [2024-11-01, 2025-10-24) of the registered forecast run (spec §6); coverage = share of scored hours with p10 ≤ residual ≤ p90; no guaranteed conditional coverage
forecast_skill.pi_rule: L permutation importance: the frozen L refitted exactly (its forecasts must match the run's), each feature group's columns shuffled together across the scored rows, MAE increase over the unshuffled MAE, averaged over 5 shuffles (numpy default_rng seed 20261027 per series and group)
